capabilities: Pseudonymize MD, TXT, CSV, DOCX and XLSX files
Create separate safe copies outside the vault
Encrypt token mappings with a passphrase
Restore AI-returned results from a JSON package
extras: Desktop-only; no telemetry or network requests; passphrase cannot be recovered; DOCX/XLSX use a fail-closed profile; PDF, legacy .doc/.xls and mobile are unsupported.
problem: Users need to share documents without exposing names or identifiers, but lack a local review workflow that preserves the originals.
summary: Desktop-only pseudonymization tool that reviews local MD, TXT, CSV, DOCX and XLSX files and writes a separate safe copy.
